EBM: Specimen → ProcessedSpecimen.</rdfs:comment> <whu:prompt xml:lang="en">### Define Preprocessing plan: storage, transport, digestion, filtration, homogenization before analysis. ### Context Extract cooling/freezing/filtering/digestion preparation procedures. ### Links isPrecededBy SpecimenCollection; ResearchStep -isStepOfPlan→ SpecimenPreprocessing; hasInputVar Specimen; hasOutputVar ProcessedSpecimen. ### Order Preceded by SpecimenCollection; precedes BioChemicalExperiment.</whu:prompt> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000030"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Class"/> <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">information content entity</rdfs:label> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://example.org/whu#hasContext"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#ObjectProperty"/> <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://example.org/whu#SpecimenCollection"/> <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://example.org/whu#EnvironmentFeature"/> <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">has context</rdfs:label> <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">Links a specimen-collection plan to one or more environment features.</rdfs:comment> <whu:prompt xml:lang="en">Define: SpecimenCollection has environmental/geographic context. Subject: SpecimenCollection; Object: EnvironmentFeature. Examples: "Samples collected from paddy soils in Nanjing" → hasContext(collection, EnvironmentFeature:paddy soil Nanjing).</whu:prompt> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://purl.org/net/p-plan#Step"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Class"/> <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">Step</rdfs:label> <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://purl.org/net/p-plan#Plan"/> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://purl.org/net/p-plan#isStepOfPlan"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#ObjectProperty"/> <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://example.org/whu#ResearchStep"/> <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://purl.org/net/p-plan#Plan"/> <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">is step of plan</rdfs:label> <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">ResearchStep belongs to a mid-level plan (Collection, Preprocessing, Experiment).</rdfs:comment> <whu:prompt xml:lang="en">Define: ResearchStep belongs to a Plan. Connect step → SpecimenCollection | SpecimenPreprocessing | BioChemicalExperiment | ComputationalExperiment. Examples: "instrument run" → isStepOfPlan(runStep, BioChemicalExperiment).</whu:prompt> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://example.org/whu#SupportGraph"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Class"/> <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">Support Graph</rdfs:label> <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://purl.org/mp#Representation"/> <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000030"/> <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Collection"/> <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:nodeID="n4b4ed2ff73364a2b9457ab8ea3233694b6"/> <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:nodeID="n4b4ed2ff73364a2b9457ab8ea3233694b7"/> <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">Argumentation structure targeting a single Claim; members are Statements and their support/challenge relations.</rdfs:comment> <whu:prompt xml:lang="en">### Define Argument package for one Claim, aggregating Statements that support or challenge it. ### Context One SupportGraph focuses on one Claim; encapsulate multi-statement argumentation. ### Links SupportGraph -prov:hadMember→ Statement; SupportGraph -mp:supports|mp:challenges→ Claim; ScienceEvidence -mp:supports|mp:challenges→ SupportGraph (or its Statements).</whu:prompt> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://example.org/whu#declaredUsed"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#ObjectProperty"/> <rdfs:subPropertyOf rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#used"/> <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://example.org/whu#ResearchStep"/> <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing"/> <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">declared used</rdfs:label> <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">Links a ResearchStep to Method, Device, Reagent or Software declared in the paper text.</rdfs:comment> <whu:prompt xml:lang="en">Define: A research step declares use of a Method, Device, Reagent or Software. Context: Extract only when text says following/according to/using [resource]. Subject: ResearchStep; Object: Method|Device|Reagent|Software. Examples: "Digestion followed EPA 3052" → declaredUsed(step, Method:EPA3052).</whu:prompt> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://example.org/whu#Specimen"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Class"/> <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">Specimen</rdfs:label> <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Entity"/> <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">Collected biological or environmental specimen (physical carrier).</rdfs:comment> <whu:prompt xml:lang="en">### Define Physical sample collected from an environment before or without full preprocessing. ### Context Must be traceable to EnvironmentFeature; typically output of SpecimenCollection ResearchStep. ### Examples "rice grains"; "fish tissue"; "soil cores"; "river water samples". ### Links ResearchStep(Collection) -hasOutputVar→ Specimen; ResearchStep(Preprocessing) -hasInputVar→ Specimen; Specimen -wasDerivedFrom→ EnvironmentFeature.</whu:prompt> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://purl.org/net/p-plan#hasInputVar"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#ObjectProperty"/> <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://example.org/whu#ResearchStep"/> <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing"/> <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">has input variable</rdfs:label> <whu:prompt xml:lang="en">Define: ResearchStep consumes Specimen, ProcessedSpecimen or DataSet as typed input. "analyzed by ICP-MS". ### Links ResearchStep -declaredUsed→ Method; Method ∈ ScienceEvidence via prov:hadMember.</whu:prompt> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://example.org/whu#Reagent"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Class"/> <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">Reagent</rdfs:label> <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Entity"/> <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">Chemical or biological reagent used in sample treatment or analysis.</rdfs:comment> <whu:prompt xml:lang="en">### Define Reagent including concentration/unit/role when stated. ### Examples "HNO3"; "HgCl2 solution (~5 μg/g)". ### Links ResearchStep -declaredUsed→ Reagent.</whu:prompt> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://example.org/whu#Goal"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Class"/> <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">Goal</rdfs:label> <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Entity"/> <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000030"/> <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">Formalized research objective of an experiment.</rdfs:comment> <whu:prompt xml:lang="en">### Define Explicit experimental objective (question/aim). ### Examples "evaluate cadmium levels in rice"; EBM: EnvironmentFeature → Specimen.</rdfs:comment> <whu:prompt xml:lang="en">### Define A sampling/collection plan that produces Specimen from environmental context. ### Context Extract when text describes field sampling, sample acquisition, collection sites/dates. ### Links SpecimenCollection -hasContext→ EnvironmentFeature; ResearchStep -isStepOfPlan→ SpecimenCollection; ResearchStep -hasOutputVar→ Specimen. ### Order SpecimenCollection precedes SpecimenPreprocessing (p-plan:isPrecededBy).</whu:prompt> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Collection"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Class"/> <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">PROV Collection</rdfs:label> <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Entity"/> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://example.org/whu#hasComparator"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#DatatypeProperty"/> <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://example.org/whu#ScalarMeasurementDatum"/> <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string"/> <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">Optional comparator: <, >, <=, >=, between.</rdfs:comment> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://example.org/whu/BAE_v2"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Ontology"/> <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">BAE Ontology v2</rdfs:label> <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">Background–Activity–Evidence ontology for natural-science paper KG extraction and GraphRAG.</rdfs:comment> <owl:versionInfo>2.0</owl:versionInfo> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://example.org/whu#ProcessedSpecimen"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Class"/> <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">Processed Specimen</rdfs:label> <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Entity"/> <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">Specimen after preprocessing; input to BioChemicalExperiment. Material IO, not argumentative evidence.</rdfs:comment> <whu:prompt xml:lang="en">### Define Material resulting from specimen preprocessing (digestion, filtration, homogenization). ### Context Output of Preprocessing steps; input to biochemical experimental steps. ### Examples "digested solution"; "filtered porewater"; "homogenized powder". ### Links ResearchStep(Preprocessing) -hasOutputVar→ ProcessedSpecimen; ResearchStep(Bio) -hasInputVar→ ProcessedSpecimen; ProcessedSpecimen -wasDerivedFrom→ Specimen.</whu:prompt> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:nodeID="n4b4ed2ff73364a2b9457ab8ea3233694b1"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Restriction"/> <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="http://purl.org/net/p-plan#isPrecededBy"/> <owl:someValuesFrom rdf:resource="http://example.org/whu#SpecimenCollection"/> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://purl.org/net/p-plan#Plan"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Class"/> <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">Plan</rdfs:label> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://example.org/whu#DataSet"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Class"/> <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">DataSet</rdfs:label> <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://purl.org/mp#Data"/> <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000100"/> <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#Dataset"/> <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Entity"/> <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">Structured scientific dataset; argumentative mp:Data + structured iao:DataSet.</rdfs:comment> <whu:prompt xml:lang="en">### Define Structured dataset (table, figure, file, measurement collection) generated or used in research. ### Context Extract when text names datasets/tables/figures/results that support or challenge claims. NOT instantiable in operational KG.</rdfs:comment> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://example.org/whu#hasGoal"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#ObjectProperty"/> <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://example.org/whu#BioChemicalExperiment"/> <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://example.org/whu#ComputationalExperiment"/> <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://example.org/whu#Goal"/> <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">has goal</rdfs:label> <whu:prompt xml:lang="en">Define: An experiment has an explicit scientific Goal. Look for "to quantify/assess/compare/evaluate …". Examples: "to compare metal levels across regions" → hasGoal(experiment, goal).</whu:prompt> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://purl.org/net/p-plan#hasOutputVar"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#ObjectProperty"/> <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://example.org/whu#ResearchStep"/> <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing"/> <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">has output variable</rdfs:label> <whu:prompt xml:lang="en">Define: ResearchStep produces Specimen, ProcessedSpecimen or DataSet as typed output. Examples: "ICP-MS generated concentration data" → hasOutputVar(step, DataSet).</whu:prompt> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#closeMatch"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#AnnotationProperty"/> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000027"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Class"/> <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">data item</rdfs:label> <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000030"/> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#exactMatch"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#AnnotationProperty"/> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://purl.org/mp#Representation"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Class"/> <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">Representation</rdfs:label> <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000030"/> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://example.org/whu#ExecutionEnvironment"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Class"/> <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">Execution Environment</rdfs:label> <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Entity"/> <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">Experimental conditions: temperature, humidity, duration.</rdfs:comment> <whu:prompt xml:lang="en">### Define Controlled experimental conditions with numeric values/units. ### Examples "180 °C for 30 min"; "incubated at 25 °C". ### Links ResearchStep -hasExecutionEnvironment→ ExecutionEnvironment.</whu:prompt> </rdf:Description> <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Entity"> <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Class"/> <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">PROV Entity</rdfs:label> </rdf:Description> </rdf:RDF>
